verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-request mail scanning (docs-19), unlimited cloud storage with 24/7 access (docs-41), and tagging "so it's easier to find later" (docs-37). For registered-agent mail, scanned PDFs are stored so you can "find and organize" documents (docs-40). Nothing in the evidence mentions OCR or full-text search, so the core of the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: any documented OCR of scans, search by mail content, search or filtering by sender and date, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search behavior.
